_comment: DO NOT GUESS. Childcare / friend coverage is set ONLY by the user, per study — never inferred by a model. An earlier version INVENTED per-city likelihoods (e.g. 'San Diego: likely', 'Phoenix: likely') and let them rank studies. That was wrong and is removed. This file ships as ANONYMIZED EXAMPLE data only — generic city + coverage note, never a real friend's name or identifying detail. A national city list can justify listing studies nationwide (a user may be willing to travel) without that being a childcare confirmation. Default every location to UNKNOWN; the user decides coverage study-by-study.
rule: Never assign childcare coverage from a model. Only the user sets it. Ranking MUST NOT depend on guessed childcare — rank on pay, nights, drive-vs-fly, payout timing, eligibility.

user_stated_coverage.note: Example: user has friends there who could provide childcare coverage.
Example: metro is a short drive from the user's home base and they have contacts there who offered to help for a weekend stay. Nothing beyond that is confirmed.
Example: user has contacts in this metro.

national_note: Example cities a user might name to justify listing studies nationwide. These are NOT childcare confirmations — coverage is never assumed from this list. Do not mark coverage for them.
